high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "karthi_offl." The post features two men standing side by side against a neutral-colored wall with a dark-framed door in the background. Both men are dressed in traditional white attire, which appears to be a combination of a white shirt and white dhoti or lungi. The man on the left has short, dark hair and a neatly trimmed beard, while the man on the right has slightly longer, dark hair and a full beard. The man on the right is holding a smartphone in his left hand. He also wears a wristwatch on his left wrist
